## Pull request overview

Fixes a schema sync bug in `@objectstack/driver-sql` where DDL used the object schema’s FQN (e.g. `sys__user`) instead of the physical table name (e.g. `sys_user`), which caused runtime queries (auth) to fail with missing-table errors.

**Changes:**
- Update `SqlDriver.syncSchema()` to pass the caller-provided physical table name into table initialization.
- Update `initObjects()` to prefer an explicit `tableName` property over `name` (defense-in-depth).
- Add regression tests covering both the `syncSchema` physical-name behavior and `initObjects` tableName preference; document the fix in `CHANGELOG.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts | Ensures schema sync/DDL uses the physical table name; adds `tableName` preference in `initObjects`. |
| packages/plugins/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema.test.ts | Adds regression tests for physical-name DDL behavior and `tableName` precedence. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the driver-level fix for the physical-vs-FQN table naming mismatch. |
